# COS597C Project 1 — Differentiating No-Action Outcomes in Agent Evaluations

τ²-bench gives credit to agents that do nothing. We change it so that a no-action
verdict is graded as **justified** or **unjustified**.

Hammad Farooqi · Vatsal Parikh · Princeton COS597C, Fall 2026
